name: Lace Hanging Tapestry
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from soft, lightweight sheer mesh fabric for an elegant and airy appearance.
    - Finished with exquisite floral lace trim for a romantic and delicate look.
    - Lace trim width: approximately 8 cm.
    - Equipped with durable metal grommets for convenient and secure hanging.
    - Suitable for indoor display and covered event spaces.
    📌 Note: Ribbons not included.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 4 sizes:
              +) 10 x 30 in ~ 25.4 x 76.2 cm
              +) 12 × 40 in ~ 30.48 × 101.6 cm
              +) 15 × 50 in ~ 38.1 × 127 cm
              +) 20 × 60 in ~ 50.8 × 152.4 cm
    📌 Note: Manual measurement may result in a size variation of ±3 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Features one-sided printing on the sheer mesh fabric.
    📌 Note:
    - Colors may vary by up to 5% between the mockup and the finished product.
    - Neon colors, metallic colors, and special effects are not supported and cannot be accurately reproduced during printing.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for decorating baby showers, birthday parties, weddings, bridal showers, anniversaries, graduation parties, retirement celebrations, memorial events, and holiday gatherings.
    - Ideal for use as a welcome sign, event backdrop, wall decoration, photo booth backdrop, party entrance banner, or home décor accent.
    - Lightweight and foldable design makes it easy to hang, transport, store, and reuse for multiple occasions.
    - Suitable for decorating homes, event venues, schools, churches, offices, gardens, patios, and outdoor celebrations.
    - Personalize with names, dates, event information, or custom artwork to create a unique keepsake for any special occasion.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for family, friends, couples, parents, grandparents, coworkers, teachers, or event hosts.
    - Perfect for Baby Showers, Birthdays, Weddings, Bridal Showers, Housewarmings, Graduations, Anniversaries, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Halloween, and New Year celebrations.
    - An excellent personalized decoration and keepsake that helps create lasting memories for life's most meaningful moments.
    - A unique gift choice for anyone who enjoys customized home décor and beautifully decorated special events.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 8 – 15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Lace Hanging Tapestry

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow  3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
